source_title: Mika Singh remembers late Sanjay Gupta as his ‘Godfather’; says ‘You gave me my first Bollywood break’
source_excerpt: Singer Mika Singh seemed to be in a disturbed state of mind post the demise of filmmaker Sanjay Gupta.He remembered him as a "godfather" who gave him his first Bollywood break.Mika took to his social media account to share an emotional tribute to the filmmaker, describing him as a wonderful human being, a down-to-earth personality and an incredible filmmaker, director and producer.Sharing a picture with the filmmaker, Mika wrote, "Today has been one of the most shocking and heartbreaking days for me. My big brother, Sanjay Gupta Ji, a wonderful human being, a down-to-earth personality, and an incredible filmmaker, director and producer, has left us far too soon."Recalling how Sanjay Gupta helped him make his entry into Bollywood, Mika said that the filmmaker had been like a godfather to him and would always remain someone he was grateful to."Bhai, you were like a godfather to me. You gave me my very first Bollywood break, and I will always be grateful for your love, guidance and support," he further wrote."You will forever remain in my heart. May Waheguru bless your soul with eternal peace and give strength to the family to bear this irreparable loss. Rest in peace, Bhai. You will be deeply missed."Mika's first major Bollywood break came with the song 'Ganpat' from Sanjay Gupta's 2007 film 'Shootout at Lokhandwala'. The track, featuring Vivek Oberoi, became a popular number and helped establish Mika's presence in the Hindi film music industry.For the uninitiated, Sanjay Gupta passed away on October 30 at his residence in Mumbai at the age of 59. Reportedly, he slipped in the bathroom during the night and sustained a head injury.Reports stated that the incident went unnoticed until the following morning, when he was found dead. His family members were reportedly at home but were unaware of the fall at the time.Sanjay Gupta made his directorial debut with 'Aatish: Feel the Fire' in 1994. Over the years, he directed films such as 'Kaante', 'Musafir', 'Zinda', 'Shootout at Wadala', 'Jazbaa', 'Kaabil' and 'Mumbai Saga'. hi_body:
गायक मीका सिंह ने हाल ही में फिल्म निर्माता संजय गुप्ता के निधन पर एक भावुक श्रद्धांजलि साझा की, जिन्हें उन्होंने अपना "गॉडफादर" और बॉलीवुड में पहला ब्रेक देने वाला शख्स बताया। स्थापित मनोरंजन प्रकाशनों के अनुसार, गायक ने सोशल मीडिया पर फिल्म निर्माता के निधन पर गहरा शोक और आश्चर्य व्यक्त किया है।

संजय गुप्ता का 30 अक्टूबर को मुंबई स्थित उनके आवास पर 59 वर्ष की आयु में निधन हो गया। मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, रात में बाथरूम में कथित तौर पर फिसलने से उनके सिर में चोट लग गई थी, और इस घटना का पता अगली सुबह चला।

## मीका सिंह की श्रद्धांजलि और बॉलीवुड सफर

अपने सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट में, मीका सिंह ने दिवंगत निर्देशक को एक अद्भुत इंसान और बेहतरीन फिल्म निर्माता बताया।

* **पहला ब्रेक:** मीका ने स्वीकार किया कि गुप्ता ने उन्हें बॉलीवुड में उनका पहला बड़ा ब्रेक दिया था।
* **लोकप्रिय गाना:** यह सहयोग 2007 की फिल्म 'शूटआउट एट लोखंडवाला' के लोकप्रिय गाने 'गणपत' के साथ आया था, जिसने हिंदी फिल्म संगीत उद्योग में गायक की पहचान बनाने में मदद की।
* **आभार:** मीका ने गुप्ता के मार्गदर्शन और समर्थन के लिए हमेशा आभारी रहने की बात कही।

## फिल्म निर्माण करियर

संजय गुप्ता ने 1994 में फिल्म 'आतिश: फील द फायर' से अपने निर्देशन की शुरुआत की थी। अपने करियर के दौरान उन्होंने कई उल्लेखनीय फिल्मों का निर्देशन किया:

* कांटे
* मुसाफिर
* जिंदा
* शूटआउट वडाला
* जज़्बा
* काबिल
* मुंबई सागा
* द मिरांडा ब्रदर्स (2025 में रिलीज़)

इन विवरणों को सत्यापित करने के लिए पाठक आधिकारिक मनोरंजन समाचार और सत्यापित उद्योग प्रकाशनों की घोषणाओं को देख सकते हैं।

en_body:
Singer Mika Singh recently shared an emotional tribute following the demise of filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, whom he remembered as his "godfather" and the person who gave him his first Bollywood break. According to established entertainment publications, the singer expressed shock and sorrow over the filmmaker's passing on his social media accounts.

Sanjay Gupta passed away on October 30 at his Mumbai residence at the age of 59. Reports from news outlets indicate that he sustained a head injury after reportedly slipping in the bathroom during the night, an incident that went unnoticed until the following morning.

## Mika Singh's Tribute and Bollywood Legacy

In his social media post, Mika Singh described the late director as a wonderful human being and an incredible filmmaker, director, and producer. 

* **First Break:** Mika acknowledged that Gupta gave him his very first major Bollywood break.
* **Notable Collaboration:** That initial breakthrough came with the popular track 'Ganpat' from the 2007 film 'Shootout at Lokhandwala', which helped establish the singer in the Hindi film music industry.
* **Lasting Gratitude:** Mika expressed enduring gratitude for Gupta's guidance and support.

## Filmmaking Career

Sanjay Gupta made his directorial debut in 1994 with 'Aatish: Feel the Fire'. Over a career spanning decades, he directed several notable films:

* *Kaante*
* *Musafir*
* *Zinda*
* *Shootout at Wadala*
* *Jazbaa*
* *Kaabil*
* *Mumbai Saga*
* *The Miranda Brothers* (released in 2025)

Readers seeking to verify these details can consult official entertainment news archives and announcements from verified industry publications.
